label: The nine give the Dei Filius attributes via IMMENSE_2 and INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 (inference)
rule: Composition of the registered nineGiveDeiFilius without its immense and incomprehensible bridges, on primitives whose Immense is creator of all and whose Incomprehensible is infinity, then IMMENSE_2, INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 and the two sense bridges at the same being
meaning: At any being g with the nine, the registered nineGiveDeiFilius (result of argument 1fa790f2) is applied with every input except 'Whatever causes the being of everything else is IMMENSE_1' and 'Whatever is INFINITE_1 is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1', on the primitives that agree with the given ones except that their Immense is IsCreatorOfAll and their Incomprehensible is Infinite; those two bridges then hold trivially and nothing about the given Immense and Incomprehensible is used, and every conjunct except immense and incomprehensible is carried over. g is IMMENSE_2 and INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 (the two nine-statements), so the sense bridges give g IMMENSE_1 and INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1. The senses are not identified: each passage is one listed bridge premise. Joint satisfiability of the whole premise bundle is not checked (unresolved): the controls witness the new premises together with the nine, not every premise of this route at once. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
